edits.from: From our roots as Au Lac do Brazil in 2003, Salanca Brazil has preserved over two decades of Churrasco heritage in Vietnam. In 2026, the journey continues at our new home at 49 Phan Bội Châu, Hanoi — where charcoal fire and warm hospitality bring every table together.

edits.from: In 2006, South American charcoal flavours arrived in Hanoi at 6 Cao Bá Quát. The aroma of sizzling Picanha brought a distinctive dining experience to the capital. For a decade, the restaurant held memories of family reunions, diplomatic gatherings and meetings with international friends.
edits.to: In 2006, South American charcoal flavours arrived in Hanoi at 6 Cao Ba Quat. The aroma of sizzling Picanha brought a distinctive dining experience to the capital. For a decade, the restaurant held memories of family reunions, diplomatic gatherings and meetings with international friends.

edits.from:
In 2016, the restaurant moved to 25 Trần Bình Trọng, offering a warmer, more elegant and peaceful setting for diplomatic dinners and formal gatherings.

In 2020, the brand officially took the name Salanca Brazil. This strategic repositioning brought comprehensive standards to premium imported beef, precise charcoal temperature control and a curated collection of South American wines. The new name embraces contemporary standards while preserving the original flame and honest flavours that have been cherished since 2003.

edits.from: In 2026, Salanca Brazil began a new chapter at 49 Phan Bội Châu, in the cultural and culinary heart of Hanoi. Our new home brings together refined contemporary architecture and Brazil’s warm tropical spirit. The charcoal fires keep burning as we welcome old friends to raise a glass and write new stories around the table.
